  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Record what each phase requires of your people, what it produces, the capability it needs, the gate you enforce
    today, and an honest readiness rating. Name one person for each phase; for an Absent phase, that person is also
    the remediation owner. Use the ADAPT row to name who may replan mid-execution.
  </div>
  <div class="ws-block">
    <h2>F. Operating model <span class="ws-block-note">One entry per fixed phase; name a remediation owner in the role field whenever readiness is Absent.</span></h2>
    <table class="ws">
      <colgroup><col style="width:10%"><col style="width:17%"><col style="width:13%"><col style="width:15%"><col style="width:15%"><col style="width:15%"><col style="width:15%"></colgroup>
      <thead>
        <tr>
          <th><span class="fno">21</span>F. Operating model — Phase</th>
          <th><span class="fno">22</span>F. Operating model — Human decision this phase requires</th>
          <th><span class="fno">23</span>F. Operating model — Named role who makes it</th>
          <th><span class="fno">24</span>F. Operating model — Phase output</th>
          <th><span class="fno">25</span>F. Operating model — Enabling capability: have / must build</th>
          <th><span class="fno">26</span>F. Operating model — Gate that exists today</th>
          <th><span class="fno">27</span>F. Operating model — Readiness</th>
        </tr>
      </thead>
      <tbody>
